info.name: Go-CRUD API - Complete Collection
info.description: Complete API collection with Health, Version, Auth, Users, Products (including stock management), Vehicles, Waiting List (with Queue Progress, Mechanic Assignment, Detailed Ticket Count & Weekly Availability), Service Items (predefined services with auto-pricing), Job Management & Scheduler Control, Invoices, Analytics (with Visitor Statistics by Time Period & Service Category), Roles & Pagination. Updated Feb 2026 with weekly ticket system, service items, mechanic assignment, job scheduler with database-driven job management, and visitor analytics. Admin can create/manage scheduled jobs and control system activation.

query.description: Any date within the week you want to check

request.description: Check if tickets are still available for the week containing the specified date. System uses WEEKLY limits (20 tickets per week, Monday-Sunday). Cannot book for previous weeks. You can choose any date within an available week.

response.name: Available Week
Week Full
Previous Week Error

request.description: Get real-time progress of service including position in queue, estimated wait time, and status

Cancel your own queue ticket. When you cancel, your ticket is returned to the system and other customers behind you in the queue are automatically moved up. You can only cancel your own tickets (verified by customer ID). Cannot cancel tickets that are already completed or already cancelled.

response.name: Success Response

request.description: Admin & Mechanic can view progress of ALL users' queues for a specific date. Shows customer names, phone numbers, vehicle details, mechanic name (if assigned), and complete progress information for each ticket.

Mechanic/Admin can view all available queues (waiting or called status) that are ready to be serviced. Shows customer details, vehicle info, and service type to help mechanic choose which customer to service first.

Mechanic assigns themselves to service a specific queue. This allows mechanics to choose which customer they want to service first. The mechanic's name will be shown in the queue details and progress.

item.name: Update Queue - Mechanic Adds Estimate & Notes

request.description: Mechanic/Admin updates the queue after inspection with time estimate (in minutes) and notes. This is the NEW endpoint for mechanic updates.
Call the customer - changes status to 'called' (Admin & Mechanic only)
Start the service - changes status to 'in_service'
Complete the service - changes status to 'completed' (Admin & Mechanic only)
Mark customer as no-show - changes status to 'no_show' (Admin & Mechanic only)
